LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences
2. use prepositions correctly in oral and written contexts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use prepositions correctly in oral and written contexts
   In simple words: practise until you can use prepositions correctly in oral and written contexts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions.
4. Show that you can: identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Play grade-appropriate preposition games online or offline,
2. Construct sentences using prepositions,
3. Complete substitution exercises using prepositions,
4. Self-efficacy: The learner develops confidence and self-esteem when using prepositions correctly.
5. Digital Literacy: The learner interacts with technology through watching videos and television programmes and seeing how people use prepositions in conversation.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are?
2. How do we show the position of people and things?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences
2. use prepositions correctly in oral and written contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
